note: The vans of the blueprint van (Xuong.Models.Van). Lengths in meters. A trace is a line of points [d, z]: d back from the front (or from the back), z up from the ground; "top" is the height of the roof. The points of a trace over 2 m stretch to the height of the model, so the cab keeps its height.

ford_transit.name: Ford Transit (US, 2020 to 2026)
sources: The traces of the side: the previews of the drawings of Outlines (getoutlines.com), 2019 to 2023, as in DIY, and the side photo of the owner (a Transit 148 in, medium roof).

Ford, Transit Body Builders Layout Book, 2022 model year, pages 18 to 24, and 2025 Ford Transit Technical Specifications, page 4: the length, the width, the heights, the wheelbase, the overhangs, the tracks, the openings of the doors, the height of the floor.

Measured on side photos of dealers (2022, 2023 and 2026 Transit-250, high roof, 148 in), with the wheelbase as the scale: the hood, the windshield, the lamps, the bands, the bumpers, the mirrors, the seams of the doors.
ford_transit.front_note: The center line of the front, from the bottom of the bumper to the top of the windshield: Ford, Body Builders Layout Book 2022, page 21 (the cab, near to scale), and the side photos of dealers.
